backend.mixed_label_method: evaluate sigma-selected subbraid by the generic sigma backend; multiply by (-1)^lk for psi-sigma linking and by component twists
backend.sigma_backend: left-associated fusion-path matrices for all-sigma selected subbraids; no hard-coded n<=3 selected-strand cap in this B3 implementation

exact_output.claim_level: B3 generic fusion-path backend / sigma sublinks plus Omega expansion

move_regressions.name: generic-r-r-inverse-cancellation-middle-strands
move_regressions.reason: local R followed by R^{-1} cancels with four visible strands

move_regressions.name: generic-four-strand-positive-markov
move_regressions.reason: closure(beta) equals closure(beta sigma_n) beyond the B2 n<=3 sigma path

move_regressions.name: generic-four-strand-negative-markov
move_regressions.reason: closure(beta) equals closure(beta sigma_n^-1) beyond the B2 n<=3 sigma path

move_regressions.name: generic-four-strand-conjugation
move_regressions.reason: closure(beta) equals closure(alpha beta alpha^-1) with a four-strand beta

exact_output.not_scope: full mixed-label F/R generator matrices, arbitrary planar tensor graph, cup/cap/eval/coeval programs, special/dotted links, closed 4-manifold normalization, or exotic-pair computation
exact_output.scope: generic left-associated fusion-path basis for arbitrary-length all-sigma SU(2)_2 braid sequences; fixed mixed labels via unit transparency and psi-sigma linking scalar; Omega_0/Omega_1 expansion for supported braid closures

notes: This is B3: arbitrary-length all-sigma fusion-path matrices feed the fixed-label and Omega evaluator.
The SU(2)_2 braid oracle is used only as an independent exact comparison backend.
Full mixed-label F/R generator matrices remain an explicit next step.
